facts.fact: The Partnership Compact (March 2023) says UNICEF supports system strengthening in the education sector, including 'the digital transformation strategy'; it states no amount and does not say whether the support is money or technical help, and gives the strategy's date as the Compact's own (2023).

systems.tiers: named in an education-sector funding paragraph, beside the Education Management Information System and school connectivity; no description of scope, owner or adoption

note: Passages only. The one named strategy is not described, so its class is left empty; the single fact is the dated UNICEF support, as the document words it. Nothing on standing, period, plan or reporting.
